text:
No option can be put forward from this run, because the **monthly churn <4%** limit was not scored.

- The price comparison itself held up under the changes tested, but it does not establish compliance with your churn requirement; the modelled churn output is not on a comparable scale to that limit.
- The result also assumes the goal means maximising MRR, rather than reaching £20k within 12 months; that timing condition was not evaluated.
- The comparison is most sensitive to the Pro subscriber base, which is an Olumi estimate rather than a user-supplied figure.

So this is a provisional MRR comparison, not an answer to whether raising Pro to **£59/month** meets both of your stated conditions.
